craft_notes: Sthāyin: offering-asked (thread/flowers/incense/lamp). Rows: row 2 (take→use?). Close: use (kutas as landing: WHAT use). Rejected: 'idolatry critique' — killed: kept asking (the verse asks, never denounces); print variant apraṇasya noted in lore (kept aghrāṇa).

lines: Thread for the propless, blooms for the wishless.
Noseless, take incense; eyeless, take lamp — to what use?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirālambasyopavītaṃ puṣpaṃ nirvāsanasya ca | aghrāṇasya kuto dhūpaścakṣurhīnasya dīpakaḥ
